Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — we still don't have a solid playbook for CP-separated private endpoints when egress/peering breaks. Want a short Ops-friendly failure-mode checklist before we ship the rollout.
AJ: +1. can we enumerate failure tiers? i.e. transient packet loss vs peering flapped vs full CP unreachability.
Devon: Rough tiers I use: 
- Tier 1: transient path loss (<30s) -> retry + keep alive
- Tier 2: sustained flaps (30s-5m) -> route to regional relay and alert
- Tier 3: CP unreachable (>5m) -> failover to shared egress with policy enforcement
Khan: important: preserve source IP where customer relies on IP allowlists. our shared-egress option loses src IP unless we have NAT-preserve mapping.
Olivia (ops): ops playbook should show exact commands + detection thresholds. i can write runbook but need final decision on routing order.
Maria Chen: Proposed order: 1) local retry/prefix-cache refresh, 2) regional relay (same region), 3) customer-designated fallback (peer or NAT gateway), 4) shared egress as last resort. Thoughts?
AJ: Agree but add fast path: if the customer has dedicated capacity (Dedicated), skip shared egress and go to their dedicated pool.
Devon: Also need safety for data residency/compliance -> must respect per-tenant "egress_policy: no_shared_egress" label. Fallback should check label before step4.
Khan: For preservation we can do a 2min ephemeral SNAT mapping from tenant IP -> preserved external IP using our egress-operator. If not possible, tag alert with "ip-preservation-failed" and include suggested mitigation.
Olivia (ops): Runbook snippet draft:
```
Detect: cp_peer_health < 90% for 30s -> incident page
Mitigate: trigger regional-relay (route change via controlplane api)
Escalate: if relay fails for 5m -> enable fallback-egress (checks: tenant.egs.allow_shared=false?)
Postmortem: capture flow logs + kv-cache hits, run tokenized prompt replay for affected requests
```
Maria Chen: Nice. Who owns the controlplane API change to expose `enable_fallback_egress` and tenant label check?
Devon: I'll own API surface. Plan: `POST /tenants/{id}/egress-fallback` with body `{ "mode": "regional-relay" | "shared-egress" | "dedicated-pool" }`. We'll add a guard that returns 403 if tenant labels disallow it.
AJ: Dev, make sure the API is idempotent and emits an event to `egress.operations` topic for auditing. We need traceability for SLA credits.
Devon: yep — events include reason, source (auto/manual), and correlation_id.
Khan: Observability: add a histogram for fallback latency (time from detection -> traffic served on new path) and a counter for fallback type. Also surface top-3 affected tenants in Console.
Olivia (ops): For runbook, also include remediation steps for NAT exhaustion (we saw this in prod simulation). e.g., pre-allocate ephemeral port ranges per tenant and have operator playbook to rotate.
Maria Chen: Ops escalation matrix:
- 0-2m: auto-retries, sampling logs
- 2-10m: regional relay + page oncall (severity P2)
- >10m: enable fallback-egress + page infra + exec notify (severity P1)
AJ: add canary rollback hook: if fallback increases error-rate >5% for 5m, rollback to previous routing and open incident runbook.
Devon: Security note: shared-egress must strip tenant metadata headers. add `X-Tenant-Id` scrubber in the egress path.
Khan: Also add a QA spike to exercise the fallback in staging with these permutations: private endpoint + allow_shared_egress=true/false, dedicated pool tagged, NAT exhaustion simulated.
Olivia (ops): I'll own the staged runbook test. suggest runbook PR with checklists (test plan, expected metrics, rollback steps).
Maria Chen: Next steps: Devon to PR the API spec by EOD Friday, Khan to add metrics dashboard stub, Olivia to draft ops runbook, AJ to add audit event shape and SLA impacts. I'll coordinate rollout gating with product.
AJ: ping @oncall (not present) when we have the staged test window.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: controlplane/api v2.14 -> staging (build 4929) :rocket:
Devon: noted deploy, will branch off staging for API changes.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — will sync in AR meeting Wed. Posting a one-pager soon. :thumbsup:
